title: Opus radio streams, with IYAKKI's own decoder (manual until automated)

clauses.text: A live Opus station plays through IYAKKI's own helper at normal pitch and speed, without cutting out.

steps.do: Play a live Opus station for at least three minutes.
steps.expect: It plays with natural pitch and speed and does not cut out. Note any crackle or drop-out and when it happened.

clauses.text: Opus plays without the ffmpeg add-on installed, because the own helper is tried first.

steps.do: Check that the ffmpeg add-on is not installed, then play the Opus station.
